cohort: 146 consecutive patients treated for VVF in Kisantu, DR Congo between November 2006 and November 2012
finding: Vesicovaginal fistula can occur after caesarean section due to prolonged labor causing ischemia and necrosis of the bladder wall and vesicovaginal septum before or during the procedure, resulting in a 65% closure rate and 63% continence rate among those with successful closure.
mod_finding: The majority of participants (63.4%) underwent a caesarean section.
